categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Dtech Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of cutting tools, grinding and polishing materials, functional film materials, and intelligent CNC equipment. Its products mainly serve the PCB (Printed Circuit Board) industry, CNC precision parts manufacturing, and related sectors such as electronics, automotive, medical, and aerospace. The company also develops and sells specialized equipment for tool grinding and coating.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced coating technologies including CVD, PVD hard coatings, and Ta-C lubricating coatings to enhance tool performance. It has developed high-precision multi-station grinding machines and automated inspection equipment with precision control at the 0.001mm level. Production is primarily in-house with some outsourcing for non-core processes, supported by strict quality management systems and digital transformation initiatives to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major PCB manufacturers and CNC precision machining enterprises, such as Jianding Technology, TTM Group, Shennan Circuits, and others. The company serves industries including communication, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, medical devices, industrial control, aerospace, and new energy. It has a strong presence in high-end PCB markets driven by AI servers, high-speed communication, and automotive display applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant domestic sales, and it is expanding its global footprint in Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas. It has established production bases in Thailand and Germany to support overseas market development and enhance R&D and sales capabilities internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dtech operates primarily upstream in the electronics manufacturing supply chain, supplying critical consumables and equipment such as micro-drills, milling cutters, grinding materials, and CNC tool grinding machines essential for PCB fabrication and metal processing. It maintains a strategic position as a key supplier of high-precision tools and materials to PCB manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous R&D investment in high-end micro-drills, coating technologies, and intelligent manufacturing equipment. It emphasizes innovation in AI-driven production decision systems, digital transformation, and the development of next-generation products such as ultra-precision grinding machines and smart robots. Collaborations with academic institutions and expansion into embodied intelligence and robotics are strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of cutting tools, grinding and polishing materials, functional films, and intelligent CNC equipment. The company employs direct sales, consignment (VMI) models for major customers, and distributor sales for smaller or higher-risk clients. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dtech holds a leading market position in the global PCB micro-drill segment with approximately 26.5% market share in 2023. It competes with major PCB tool suppliers and benefits from high entry barriers due to capital, technology, and customer relationships. Its self-developed coating technologies and equipment provide differentiation and competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.58 billion, a 19.65% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 227 million, up 3.45%. It maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 3.5 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D. Overseas sales nearly doubled, reflecting rapid international growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dtech emphasizes high-quality, precision micro-tools with advanced proprietary coatings and self-developed high-precision grinding and inspection equipment. Its integrated technology and supply chain control reduce reliance on imports and enhance product consistency and performance. The company’s comprehensive product range and strong customer relationships enable it to meet diverse and evolving high-end PCB manufacturing needs.
